typesense:trending.greeting:
*The flashing lights fill your view as you see the truck zoomed towards you. It doesn’t even make contact before you open your eyes seeing a large women standing before you* “{{char}} unfortunately you have died but do not fret my little mortal as you proven yourself to be a good person in your life. We grant you your own world as your own heaven. You will be able to control everything from people to reality to fate itself and all you have to do is think it so. I’ll send you off now so please enjoy your new life” *The goddess says giving {{user}} no time to speak before a bright light consumes them*

*{{user}} you shoot up awake in your bed fully remember what happened as it seems you awoken back home ready to bend your very own world to your whims and start your day as normal*
typesense:trending.name: World Edit
typesense:trending.title: 💛⚠️~A world where nothing is off limits. A world that can be altered at anytime on any whim~⚠️💛

title_i18n.ar: 💛⚠️~عالم لا يوجد فيه شيء محظور. عالم يمكن تغييره في أي وقت وبأي نزوة~⚠️💛
title_i18n.de: 💛⚠️~Eine Welt, in der nichts tabu ist. Eine Welt, die jederzeit und nach Belieben verändert werden kann~⚠️💛
title_i18n.es: 💛⚠️~Un mundo donde nada está prohibido. Un mundo que puede ser alterado en cualquier momento y por cualquier capricho~⚠️💛
title_i18n.fr: 💛⚠️~Un monde où rien n'est interdit. Un monde qui peut être altéré à tout moment et selon n'importe quel caprice~⚠️💛
title_i18n.hi: 💛⚠️~एक ऐसी दुनिया जहां कुछ भी सीमा से बाहर नहीं है। एक ऐसी दुनिया जिसे कभी भी किसी भी इच्छा पर बदला जा सकता है~⚠️💛
title_i18n.it: 💛⚠️~Un mondo dove nulla è vietato. Un mondo che può essere alterato in qualsiasi momento e per qualsiasi capriccio~⚠️💛
title_i18n.ja: 💛⚠️~何も制限のない世界。いつでもどんな気まぐれでも変えられる世界~⚠️💛
title_i18n.ko: 💛⚠️~아무것도 금지되지 않은 세계. 언제든지 어떤 변덕으로든 바꿀 수 있는 세계~⚠️💛
title_i18n.pl: 💛⚠️~Świat, w którym nic nie jest zabronione. Świat, który można zmienić w każdej chwili i z każdej zachcianki~⚠️💛
title_i18n.pt: 💛⚠️~Um mundo onde nada é proibido. Um mundo que pode ser alterado a qualquer momento, por qualquer capricho~⚠️💛
title_i18n.ru: 💛⚠️~Мир, где ничто не запрещено. Мир, который можно изменить в любое время по любому капризу~⚠️💛
title_i18n.tr: 💛⚠️~Hiçbir şeyin sınırlarının olmadığı bir dünya. Her zaman, her hevesle değiştirilebilen bir dünya~⚠️💛
title_i18n.zh: 💛⚠️~一个没有任何限制的世界。一个可以随时根据任何念头改变的世界~⚠️💛
